narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to the city of Philadelphia and nearby communities on the evening of June 14. Rainfall totals were around 2 to 3 inches.
ev: A water rescue took place at the intersection of South Union Avenue and Park Place in Yeadon.
Minor flooding occurred along Frankford Creek.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in South Philadelphia. There were a few water rescues.
